what: Claude Code is validated end-to-end in PHASE_1_RESULTS.md (sessions A-G); Cursor is NOT. PHASE_0_1_SPEC marks P1.9 Cursor Validation and P1.17 5-scenarios-in-Cursor as DEFERRED ("awaiting user Cursor reactivation"). External copy should claim Cursor support but hedge: "Claude Code is validated end-to-end; Cursor is supported via generated `.cursor/` config and the same MCP protocol, with tool-specific UX still being verified."
why: User rule during the external-content rebrand was "claim Claude Code AND Cursor as supported tools." But the spec is explicit that Cursor validation hasn't run. Leaving the claim un-hedged would overclaim. This guideline stays in effect until P1.9/P1.17 land — once Cursor is validated in live scenarios, the hedge can be dropped.
